title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics integration and quality gating enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: improve per-prompt signal in the eval-harness CI so we can detect prompt-set regressions earlier and gate merges on quality metrics. This PR integrates per-prompt metrics export into the CI pipeline, adds a configurable quality gating step, and wires metric thresholds to our existing alerting hooks. Changes include a new per_prompt_metrics plugin, CI job updates (GitHub Actions), an evaluation report formatter (CSV/JSON), and documentation. Checklist: - [x] implement per_prompt_metrics exporter - [x] add CI job to run evals and upload artifacts - [x] add quality gating step with configurable thresholds - [x] add unit/integration tests and fixtures - [x] update docs and runbook - [x] manual verification against historical prompt-set A/B run Overview of approach: we export per-prompt scores (accuracy, hallucination_rate, response_length, latency_ms) to the CI artifacts bucket and calculate delta vs baseline stored in the eval-registry. The gating step compares deltas against per-prompt thresholds with support for: global default thresholds, per-prompt overrides, and an allowlist for known flaky prompts. If any prompt exceeds thresholds the gate fails and posts a structured comment with top offending prompts. Backwards compatibility: the change is opt-in via eval-harness config; existing projects without per-prompt config continue to run as before. Testing: added unit tests for metrics aggregation, integration test that runs a small prompt-set in GitHub Actions, and a local tool to compute baselines and simulate gating decisions. Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag, enable for a small set of repos for 2 weeks, monitor false positive rate, then flip on org-wide. See release_notes for admin-facing changes and instructions.

release_notes: Added per-prompt metrics export and CI quality gating for the eval-harness. Admins can opt-in per project via eval-harness config. Provides per-prompt deltas for accuracy/hallucination/latency and a gating comparator that can block merges when regressions exceed thresholds. See docs/eval-harness/per-prompt-gating.md for setup and runbook.
notes_for_operators: Feature is behind 'per_prompt_gating' flag in eval-harness config. To enable: add per_prompt_gating: true and set thresholds or use defaults. Monitor eval-harness/ci/gating_errors and eval-harness/ci/gating_violations metrics in Datadog.
